name: KimplE
title: Mother of VRChat
aliases: Kimple, Detective Kimple, Battle Disc Sensei, Kittybot
description: KimplE (also known as Kimple or KimplEClonE) is one of the earliest and most iconic content creators in VRChat's history, portraying an easygoing robot cat who communicates through a text-to-speech engine. A member of [Team Five](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Team_Five) in 2017-2018, she was known for dancing, showing off a large avatar collection, and playing jokes, and is sometimes credited as one of the platform's earliest VTubers for streaming with a virtual avatar overlay while playing other games. She remained a fixture of VRChat's roleplay scene for years afterward, known for her friendly, observer-like presence in community events.
